Class_Skill_Desc_Earthen Wall: Creates a barrier around self and all nearby party members that absorbs damage equivalent to a heal of 40,000 potency.</br>Duration: 10s</br>Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.
Class_Skill_Desc_Hellfire: Deals fire damage with a potency of 600 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 780 when used against targets weak to fire.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.</br>Shares a recast timer with Judgment Bolt and Thunderstorm.
Class_Skill_Desc_Judgment Bolt: Deals lightning damage with a potency of 600 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 780 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.</br>Shares a recast timer with Hellfire and Thunderstorm.
Class_Skill_Desc_Megaflare: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 1,000 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.
Class_Skill_Desc_Thunderstorm: Deals wind damage with a potency of 600 to all enemies in a cone before you.</br>Potency increases to 780 when used against targets weak to wind.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.</br>Shares a recast timer with Hellfire and Judgment Bolt.
